div.div: The Problem: If you manually restore a snapshot into us-east-1a, but your high-performance database nodes are all in us-east-1b, the pod will never start. Kubernetes cannot "stretch" a physical cable across data centers.

div.div: The Fix: When restoring a snapshot for a PVC, you must ensure the resulting volume is in the same AZ as your nodes. Using volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer in your StorageClass helps automate this alignment during the first provisioning.
